resourcePolicy: Immutable SVG snapshots are collected synchronously and all temporary scene mutations restored before async rendering. Each native pixels getter read once. Code keeps at most2 snapshots per control and journey; source word checks run only once per each of2 cards. No production cache/export or new detector threshold.
